landing.hero_subtitle: Plan your week. Cook relaxed. Eat healthy.

vision.title: Eating healthy shouldn't be a full-time job.
vision.text: We created PrepYourMeal to take the mental chaos out of your daily routine. No more daily guessing at the fridge, no more wandering aimlessly in the supermarket. Just a clear, elegant plan for your week – making cooking what it should be: a relaxing pleasure.

features.shopping_desc: Ingredients from your plan automatically end up sorted on your digital shopping list.
features.healthy_desc: Achieve your nutritional goals effortlessly through proactive planning.
